verdict.rationale: Typesense is driven through a REST interface (community-confirmed) with a public API reference section under /docs/latest/api/ and guides that walk through creating collections, indexing, searching and filtering programmatically. An MCP server also lets agents operate Typesense Cloud. The evidence for the API reference itself is thin, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, in-depth evidence of the API reference's endpoint coverage (auth, full CRUD), and hands-on corroboration of agents using the API.
